boards.title: Gentle Boss · Call and Response
transcript: 01 Frame the call — show requester, recipient, scope, constraints and task.
02 Receive the call — acknowledgement means receipt only.
03 Choose a response — accept, clarify, limit, pause, defer or decline.
04 Clarify together — caller owns follow-up; understanding is distinct from acceptance.
05 Track the work — separate response, execution and review states.
06 Review before closure — keep the call open while required review or follow-up remains outstanding; silence is not consent.
